name: Gemini image and video generation (Interactions API, via scripts/image-to-3d/gemini_media.py)
auth: GEMINI_API_KEY from a billing-enabled Google project (name only; never the value)
environment: Local Python script calling https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions
cost: Paid: Google lists the image and video models with no free tier and bills per token; this package does not quote prices. Treat every call as paid and ask first.
network: external (prompts and any reference images are sent to Google)

io.input: text prompt, optional reference images or an earlier video interaction
io.output: PNG, JPEG or WebP images and MP4 video (SynthID-watermarked)

failureModes: no key, a free-tier project or billing off: exit code 77, use the normal procedure
model ids are retired or renamed (the Veo 3.1 previews were shut down on 2026-10-22); ids come from configuration
rate limit, overload, quota or timeout (exit code 75); a create request is never resent unless Google rejected it before doing work
a video job can outlive the local timeout and keep billing until it is resumed or cancelled
the prompt or the output can be blocked by safety checks
response shapes were read from Google's documentation and API reference and have not been seen from a live call
fallback: A user-supplied image or video, licensed retrieval, procedural SVG, CSS or Canvas assets, or another approved generator.
evidence: Documentation read on 2026-10-29 (image-generation, video, Omni, Interactions, errors and pricing pages); unit tests against a fake network layer. No live request was made, so access, billing behaviour and response parsing are untested.
